title: Kamishiro Rui — Words Overheard〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing the film we helped make together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That's all you've been saying for like the past hour.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, while we watched, I was reminded of what we had for lunch each day and all the things we had to carry up that big hill...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everything we did all came rushing back☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I could almost smell the sea air when it got to the beach scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We did make quite a lot of memories working on the film.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
It was really fun looking back while we watched.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
On the other hand...
I got a little anxious when I saw myself appear during that one scene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I found exactly where I was☆
Girl C was right on that bench feeding the pigeons!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, I also checked to see how I did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Only half of my back ended up making the final cut...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm more than happy with how we all did!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe we got to be in this film... We should try to make the most of this incredible experience and use it to put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing the scene where we got to appear was significant...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I was even more moved when I saw our names during the credits...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And not just once. We got to see our names twice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: On top of the casting credits, you, me and Tsukasa got to be mentioned as production staff!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. And you got credited as “Assistant to Mr. Ohara”, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't actually end up contributing much, but I was happy to be mentioned as such...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you didn't contribute much?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because how we ultimately shot the climax was based on Mr. Ohara's idea. Not mine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that I still have a lot to learn.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's not true! We know you did your best, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, you spent so much time trying to figure out how to make the film better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I bet everyone knows how hard you worked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I have to agree with Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You never shied away from the problem at hand. You thought long and hard about what the answer to that question was, and Bakuno said he was grateful for your efforts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right. The fact that you were credited as the director's assistant is proof that they recognize you did a good job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What she said! You were a really good assistant!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Getting to work on the film ended up being invaluable. It showed me just how deep the directing rabbit hole goes.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's so much that I've still yet to learn, but that excites me greatly.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm going to do everything possible in order to become the best director I can. I'm going to make the others feel proud.)
